# Partnership Requirements | Synapse Network

* Must comply with Discord's [ToS](<https://discord.com/terms>) and [Community Guidelines](<https://discord.com/guidelines>)
* 20+ real members (non bots)
* No everyone/here ping
* No rep4rep/j4j
## Important notes
* No edits allowed after partnership is done (We do not change invite link even if it expires)
